XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Steering hardening when starting with steering, tyre, ABS and ESP warning lights illuminated.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: ELECTRONICS | STEERING | MIL | POWER STEERING | TYRES | WHEELS | ABS | ESP | HARD | DOES NOT TURN | DOES NOT STEER | STEER | TURN | U0428 | U1123 | B1168 | C1146 | B1263 | B200F | B2000 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: 12V battery

  • Fault: When starting the engine, the steering sometimes stiffens and the power steering, tyre, ABS and ESP warning lights come on.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: U0428 (incorrect third angle sensor values), U1123 (invalid odometer values), B1168 (steering angle sensor error), C1146 (tyre pressure sensor error), B1263 (fuel flap electrical error), B200F (Control unit fault), B2000 (Control unit memory fault)

  • Cause: Faulty 12V battery

• Action: Replace the 12V battery

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The 12V battery showed no obvious malfunctions, but replacing it resolved the issues, confirming the defect.
    Following the replacement of the rear warning buzzer, no reprogramming via diagnostics is necessary, but the errors in the memory must be cleared via diagnostics.
